scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.evidence:valid: pnpm exec docsmyth compile fixtures/evidence/orders-contract.json --out output --evidence fixtures/evidence/orders-evidence.ndjson --verify-evidence --coverage
scripts.evidence:invalid: pnpm exec docsmyth compile fixtures/evidence/orders-contract.json --out output --evidence fixtures/evidence/invalid-evidence.ndjson --verify-evidence
scripts.diff:test: pnpm exec docsmyth diff fixtures/diff/base.json fixtures/diff/head-breaking.json --format text
scripts.diff:compatible: pnpm exec docsmyth diff fixtures/diff/base.json fixtures/diff/head-compatible.json --format text
scripts.release: pnpm check && pnpm smoke:pack && changeset publish
